people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: Joseph said to them, “What deed is this that you have done? Don’t you know that such a man as I can indeed do divination?”
translations.bsb: “What is this deed you have done?” Joseph declared. “Do you not know that a man like me can surely divine the truth?”
translations.kjv: And Joseph said unto them, What deed is this that ye have done? wot ye not that such a man as I can certainly divine?
translations.asv: And Joseph said unto them, What deed is this that ye have done? know ye not that such a man as I can indeed divine?
